frequency_question: How often do labor federation dispute cycles in this specific institutional context result in an executed indefinite strike within 30 days of initial escalation signals?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide or nationwide strike calls by recognized union coalitions in heavily regulated banking or public utility sectors where statutory conciliation processes apply. Excludes localized single-employer strikes.
provenance_note: claims 28 cases from only 5 named (5.6x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 28 named or clearly tracked formal industry-wide dispute cycles since 2015; 5 proceeded to actual indefinite or multi-day crippling strikes within the tight window, while the rest were deferred, resolved via conciliation, or converted to symbolic single-day stoppages.
known_gaps: Excludes minor uncoordinated regional protests that never reached national federation-level strike notice stages.
skeleton: Multi-year historical dispute rounds across major banking federations since 2015, capturing instances where strike ballots and notices were formally registered.
multiplier: 5 strike escalations resulting in executed indefinite strikes out of 28 total recorded formal escalation cycles over the past decade.
validity_reason: Labor laws, arbitration mechanisms, and federation structures remain stable over medium-term horizons.
